params.message:
The team's own assistant answers what used to become a mail

An assistant connected to gentells.com/mcp could give a text its source links, and
nothing else of the desk's work. It now also reads the guide, says what waits, finds
whether a publisher is known and read, starts a trial, and writes a question down for
development, under the same roles and the same yes as in Ask. An answer to a question
is told once, wherever the person works. Ask gets the publisher lookup too.

A publisher queued because a page of it was kept no longer says a post cited it.

Portal: Vanuit een gekoppelde assistent kan het team nu ook nakijken welke bronnen gelezen worden, een proef starten en een vraag laten noteren.
